name: Audio Check: Listening (Manual)
description: Phase 18 §85: what a person judges by ear in the Unity Editor (QA scenarios check only the logic). The tool starts the server on 127.0.0.1:7777 with two headless players; press Play and connect.

steps.description: Press Play and connect. Answer after you are in the match.
You heard rival1's AR from its direction (turn the camera: the side changes), louder near and quieter far.
Walk, sprint and crouch on grass, then on a wood floor you build (Q, click) and on stone or metal: the step speed follows the movement and each surface sounds different.
Place, edit, shoot and break a wall: each has its own sound; a collapse (break a wall under a floor) sounds different from a single break.
Take damage with and without shield: a shield hit, the shield breaking and a health hit sound different.
Pick up an item, open a chest, click menu buttons, open the map (M): each makes a short sound. Nothing loops or repeats by itself, and many sounds at once never crackle.
